PROP-01b-partial3-inv-035.text: When totalSupply == 0, exchangeRate must return initialExchangeRate, not divide by zero.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-035.assertion: forall market m: m.totalSupply == 0 => exchangeRate(m) == initialExchangeRate

locations.note: Line 93-95: if total_supply == 0 returns float::from_quotient(1, 1) (1.0) as initial rate; no divide-by-zero
